versos.grego: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί μου, χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ. τὰ αὐτὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐμοὶ μὲν οὐκ ὀκνηρόν, ὑμῖν δὲ ἀσφαλές.

controles.web: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
controles.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
controles.livre: No restante, meus irmãos, alegrai-vos no Senhor. Não me é incômodo escrever as mesmas coisas, e isso é para a vossa segurança.

versos.grego: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας, βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς ἐργάτας, βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν.

controles.web: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.
controles.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
controles.livre: Cuidado com os cães! Cuidado com os que operam o mal! Cuidado com a mutilação!

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς γάρ ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή, οἱ Πνεύματι Θεοῦ λατρεύοντες καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ πεποιθότες,

controles.web: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
controles.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
controles.livre: Pois a circuncisão somos nós, que servimos a Deus pelo Espírito, orgulhamo-nos em Cristo Jesus, e não confiamos na carne.

versos.grego: καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων πεποίθησιν καὶ ἐν σαρκί. Εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἄλλος πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί, ἐγὼ μᾶλλον·

controles.web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
controles.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
controles.livre: Embora eu também tenho como confiar na carne. Se outro alguém pensa que pode confiar na carne, ainda mais eu:

versos.grego: περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος, ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ, φυλῆς Βενιαμείν, Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων, κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος,

controles.web: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
controles.kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
controles.livre: circuncidado ao oitavo dia, da descendência de Israel, da tribo de Benjamim, hebreu de hebreus; segundo a lei, fariseu;

versos.grego: κατὰ ζῆλος διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος.

controles.web: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
controles.kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
controles.livre: segundo o zelo, perseguidor da Igreja; segundo a justiça que há na lei, irrepreensível.

versos.grego: Ἀλλὰ ἅτινα ἦν μοι κέρδη, ταῦτα ἥγημαι διὰ τὸν Χριστὸν ζημίαν.

controles.web: However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.
controles.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
controles.livre: Mas o que para mim era ganho considerei como perda, por causa de Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω

controles.web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
controles.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
controles.livre: E, na verdade, considero também todas as coisas como perda, por causa da superioridade de conhecer a Cristo Jesus, meu Senhor. Por ele aceitei perder todas essas coisas, e as considero como dejetos, a fim de que eu possa ganhar a Cristo;

versos.grego: καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ, μὴ ἔχων ἐμὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου, ἀλλὰ τὴν διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ, τὴν ἐκ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει,

controles.web: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;
controles.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
controles.livre: e que eu seja achado nele, não tendo a minha justiça proveniente da Lei, mas sim a que é pela fé em Cristo, a justiça da parte de Deus pela fé;

versos.grego: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ κοινωνίαν παθημάτων αὐτοῦ, συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;
controles.kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
controles.livre: para eu conhecer a ele, assim como o poder de sua ressurreição e a comunhão em seus sofrimentos, tornando-me conforme a ele em sua morte;

versos.grego: εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

controles.web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
controles.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
controles.livre: para que, de alguma maneira, eu alcance a ressurreição dos mortos.

versos.grego: οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι, διώκω δὲ εἰ καὶ καταλάβω, ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, if it is so that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Não que eu já a tenha obtido, ou que já seja perfeito; mas sigo a fim de alcançar aquilo para o qual eu também fui alcançado por Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: ἀδελφοί, ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν οὔπω λογίζομαι κατειληφέναι· ἓν δέ, τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος,

controles.web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,
controles.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
controles.livre: Irmãos, não considero como se já tivesse a obtido; mas uma coisa faço : esqueço as coisas que ficam para trás, e avanço para as que estão adiante,

versos.grego: κατὰ σκοπὸν διώκω εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω κλήσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: e assim persigo o alvo, rumo ao prêmio do chamado de cima, de Deus em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: Ὅσοι οὖν τέλειοι, τοῦτο φρονῶμεν· καὶ εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε, καὶ τοῦτο ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῖν ἀποκαλύψει·

controles.web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
controles.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
controles.livre: Por isso, todos nós que somos maduros, tenhamos essa mesma mentalidade; e se em algo pensais de maneira diferente, Deus também vos revelará isso.

versos.grego: πλὴν εἰς ὃ ἐφθάσαμεν, τῷ αὐτῷ στοιχεῖν.

controles.web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
controles.livre: Porém andemos conforme aquilo a que já chegamos.

versos.grego: Συνμιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, ἀδελφοί, καὶ σκοπεῖτε τοὺς οὕτως περιπατοῦντας καθὼς ἔχετε τύπον ἡμᾶς.

controles.web: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
controles.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
controles.livre: Sede meus imitadores, irmãos, e observai atentamente os que assim andam, como o exemplo que tendes em nós;

versos.grego: πολλοὶ γὰρ περιπατοῦσιν οὓς πολλάκις ἔλεγον ὑμῖν, νῦν δὲ καὶ κλαίων λέγω, τοὺς ἐχθροὺς τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
controles.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
controles.livre: pois, como muitas vezes eu vos disse, e agora também digo chorando, muitos andam como inimigos da cruz de Cristo.

versos.grego: ὧν τὸ τέλος ἀπώλεια, ὧν ὁ θεὸς ἡ κοιλία καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ αἰσχύνῃ αὐτῶν, οἱ τὰ ἐπίγεια φρονοῦντες.

controles.web: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
controles.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
controles.livre: O fim deles é a perdição. O Deus deles é o ventre, e têm orgulho do que deviam se envergonhar.  Eles se importam mais com as coisas terrenas.

versos.grego: ἡμῶν γὰρ τὸ πολίτευμα ἐν οὐρανοῖς ὑπάρχει, ἐξ οὗ καὶ Σωτῆρα ἀπεκδεχόμεθα Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν,

controles.web: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;
controles.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Mas nós somos cidadãos dos céus,  de onde também esperamos um Salvador, o Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: ὃς μετασχηματίσει τὸ σῶμα τῆς ταπεινώσεως ἡμῶν σύμμορφον τῷ σώματι τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ δύνασθαι αὐτὸν καὶ ὑποτάξαι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα.

controles.web: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
controles.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
controles.livre: Ele transformará o nosso degradante corpo, para que seja conforme o seu corpo glorioso, segundo a operação do seu poder de sujeitar para si todas as coisas.
